# AiFileAttachment

```ts
import { AiFileAttachment } from '@cake-admin/cakeand';
```

A file attached to a prompt, shown above the text in AiQueryInput. It is added from File in the + context menu (or by drag-and-drop / paste). Use it only inside the AI query input; for standalone uploads use FileUpload.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` | **required** | File name. Truncates to one line; the full name is exposed as a tooltip (title). |
| `status` | `'uploading' \| 'ready' \| 'error'` | `'ready'` | Upload state (Figma State=Uploading / Ready / Error). |
| `details` | `React.ReactNode` | — | Secondary line while ready, e.g. "PDF · 2.4 MB". Uploading and error states show their own fixed text. |
| `onRemove` | `() => void` | — | Removes the file. Renders the trailing × when provided. |
| `onRetry` | `() => void` | — | Retries a failed upload. Renders Retry in the error state when provided. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables remove / retry. |
| `segment` | `AiSegment` | `'consumer'` | AI segment (Figma "Segment") — tints the file-type tile with the segment surface gradient and flat glyph. Match the surrounding query input. |
| `icon` | `React.ReactNode` | — | File-type glyph (Figma "File type"). Defaults to an image glyph for image files (by extension) and a document glyph otherwise. |

Also accepts all `Omit<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, 'children'>` props.

## Usage

```tsx
<AiFileAttachment name="Battery-health-report.pdf" details="PDF · 2.4 MB" onRemove={remove} />
<AiFileAttachment name="Screenshot.png" details="Image · 282.6 KB" segment="commercial" />
<AiFileAttachment name="Battery-health-report.pdf" status="uploading" onRemove={cancel} />
<AiFileAttachment name="Battery-health-report.pdf" status="error" onRetry={retry} onRemove={remove} />
```

## Accessibility

- Remove and Retry are real buttons named for the file ("Remove Screenshot.png").
- The name truncates visually; the full name is in title.
- Uploading sets aria-busy and the Spinner announces "Uploading <name>".
- Error is shown by color and the "Upload failed" text.

## Do / Don't

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Keep failed files visible with Retry | Silently drop a failed upload |
| Block Send while a file is uploading | Send a prompt that references a half-uploaded file |
| Match segment to the query input | Mix segments in one input |
